title: Learn from entrepreneurs: why female business support network is of great significance
description: Lu Li, CEO of Blooming Founders, a female business support network, inspires more women to create their own path. The entrepreneurial mind is the common ingredient that unites different, successful types of business leaders, all of whom are driving progress, creating value, and generating wealth within their respective fields. Find out what makes this way of thinking different and what you can learn from it.   Discover more at https://credit-suisse.com/progress  Connect with us on: LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/credit-suisse/ Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/creditsuisse Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/creditsuisse

asr.full_text: Entrepreneurship is all about ideas and I think women have different ideas than men. We tick differently, we like different things, you know, we have a different reality, right? I started by myself and I realized that there was not a support network that was appealing. To me as a female entrepreneur. There was a real need, my own need. I think it's super important to have role models because you can't be what you can't see. You need to know that you're not the only crazy ones out there doing their own ideas. Hopefully we can create a more inclusive environment so you feel that you're a. Part of a community, you're part of a tribe. I hope to inspire more women to. Create their own paths and in the future I really would like to see more. Million, billion, even dollar businesses that are founded by women. I'm paving the way for female founders.
